name: Dpat
notes: ⚠ **`confidence` is `low`, and this is the only entry in either of the researcher's two sections marked low — the reason is stated in the entry and is repeated here: "the Soulection aesthetic and his placement context are sourced, but **no first-person workflow detail was reachable**; every parameter above is idiom inference".** He is also carried with an explicit Gate 1 caveat — "a beat-scene producer with mainstream placements rather than a chart name" — and is included because the roadmap names him and the aesthetic is genuinely distinct. What is authored is only what the entry states: a 60–80 felt half-time working tempo, which on this lane's convention is a 120–160 programmed grid with the snare on beat 3; "lo-fi and deliberately thin" drums — "a soft filtered kick on 1, a crushed or brushed snare on beat 3 (half-time), hats sparse or absent, and **heavy bit-reduction/tape saturation as part of the drum timbre rather than as an effect**. No triplet-roll carpet", so the roll rate is 0, the hats are near the floor and the transient is soft; a static single m9/maj9 fragment as the harmony; and a low end "mixed behind the pads rather than in front of them", which is a low-passed 808 with slow slides. ⚠ Every numeric value in this file is therefore **INFERRED** from an adjective, including `bpm.mode`. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` re-weighted (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry's harmony line is "sample-derived, static - a single m9/maj9 chopped fragment held over a 2-bar loop, filtered and pitched, with no cadence; harmony is a texture", and the engine's `vamp` value is *one* chord held for the whole clip (`generators::chords`: "One chord for the whole pattern") — so a `vamp`-dominant weighting rendered a **one**-chord bed the research nowhere describes. A **2-bar** loop is `2_bars_per_chord`, not a 4-bar hold, so that is the value the fragment now sits on and `vamp` drops to the minority. `1_per_bar` is not authored, and the fragment stays one sonority: over the single-chord family every cell is the same chord and only its voicing turns over, which is what "no cadence" asks for. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 855/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.3 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "heavily-filtered Rhodes, reversed samples, vinyl noise, and long reverbs; the Soulection house aesthetic is "dance music that heavily samples jazz and soul", and his contribution is the slowed, hazier end of it.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
